, support_project.sequence , support_project.title , support_project.content , support_project.url , support_project.img , support_project.published_date as publishedDate FROM support_project WHERE support_project.id = #{id}
mapper.sql: WHERE support_project.id is not NULL AND support_project.deleted = #{deleted} AND support_project.created_at >= CONCAT(#{sdate}, ' 00:00:00') AND CONCAT(#{fdate}, ' 23:59:59') >= support_project.created_at AND support_project.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')

SELECT count(support_project.id) as listsize FROM support_project

SELECT support_project.id FROM support_project
ORDER BY support_project.id ORDER BY support_project.title ORDER BY support_project.published_date DESC ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{perpage}

AND #{mark} > CONCAT(support_project.title, '_', support_project.id) ORDER BY support_project.title DESC
